findings.title: INV-15 section 5's derived sweep excludes tests/, leaving 26 live instances of the shape in the invariant gates themselves, undeclared in section 6
narrowing the firing set to bin/libexec/runners silently drops the stale-root guard for scripts/beta-qualify.sh, and section 4's derivation does not scan scripts/ so it cannot see the loss
section 2's enrolment check is itself textual — `^[[:space:]]*(source|\.)` accepts an indented or conditional `source helpers.sh` that never executes

the stale-root refusal is no longer the first thing a deferring entry point does — orchid-pump creates .orchid/runtime and the service log, and doctor/status emit their trust section, before the gate fires
